title: How many judgments changed?
hook: Two stated cases: explore a person-level versus a trial-level denominator.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How a person-level versus a trial-level denominator affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Accuracy, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare a person-level versus a trial-level denominator in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.
